body.label: Target
body.html: Enemies in a cone of length 3 within your ranged Weapon Range.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, each target is Slowed 1 until the start of your next turn. Deal 1 weapon Damage to one hit target of your choice.

surges.html: Deal 1 weapon Damage to a second hit target.

rider.title: Lock - Salvo
rider.html: You may end Lock on a hit target to make one empty cone space difficult terrain until your next turn; creatures cannot treat that space as cover.
